# cpa-antigravity-quota-guard v0.1.2

### 中文

- 修复单个账号 quota evidence 过期或探测失败时错误阻断整个 Antigravity 调度池的问题。
- 仅排除没有新鲜 evidence 的 closed/uninitialized 账号；其余账号继续按各自 breaker 状态调度。
- 保留 open/half-open 账号的受控恢复探测，全部账号均无可用 evidence 时仍 fail-closed。

### English

- Fix a single stale or failed quota probe incorrectly blocking the entire Antigravity scheduler pool.
- Exclude only closed or uninitialized accounts without fresh evidence; other accounts continue according to their own breaker state.
- Preserve controlled recovery probes for open/half-open accounts and fail closed when no account has usable evidence.
